# Psalm 78 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** A-maskil of-Asaph. Give-ear my-people to-my-teaching; incline your-ear to-words-of my-mouth.

**2** I-will-open in-a-parable my-mouth; I-will-pour-forth riddles from-of-old,

**3** Which we-have-heard and-we-know, and-our-fathers have-told to-us.

**4** Not we-will-hide from-their-children, to-generation later recounting praises-of YHWH, and-his-strength and-his-wonders which he-has-done.

**5** And-he-established a-testimony in-Jacob, and-a-law in-Israel he-set, which he-commanded our-fathers to-make-them-known to-their-children,

**6** So-that may-know a-generation later, children yet-to-be-born; may-they-arise and-tell to-their-children,

**7** And-they-may-set in-God their-confidence, and-not forget the-deeds-of God, and-his-commandments may-they-keep,

**8** And-not be like-their-fathers, a-generation stubborn and-rebellious, a-generation not it-prepared its-heart, and-not was-faithful with-God its-spirit.

**9** The-sons-of Ephraim armed shooters-of the-bow, turned in-the-day-of battle.

**10** Not they-kept the-covenant-of God, and-in-his-law they-refused to-walk.

**11** And-they-forgot his-deeds, and-his-wonders which he-had-shown-them.

**12** Before their-fathers he-did wonders, in-land-of Egypt in-field-of Zoan.

**13** He-split the-sea and-caused-them-to-pass-through, and-he-made-stand the-waters like-a-heap.

**14** And-he-led-them with-the-cloud by-day, and-all the-night with-light-of fire.

**15** He-split rocks in-the-wilderness, and-gave-drink as-from-depths abundant.

**16** And-he-brought-forth streams from-the-rock, and-caused-to-flow-down like-rivers waters.

**17** And-they-continued still to-sin against-him, to-rebel-against the-Most-High in-the-dry-land.

**18** And-they-tested God in-their-heart, to-ask food for-their-desire.

**19** And-they-spoke against-God; they-said, 'Is-God-able to-prepare a-table in-the-wilderness?'

**20** Behold he-struck the-rock and-flowed waters and-streams overflowed; 'Also bread is-he-able to-give? Or can-he-prepare meat for-his-people?'

**21** Therefore heard YHWH and-was-furious, and-fire was-kindled in-Jacob, and-also anger went-up against-Israel,

**22** Because not they-believed in-God, and-not they-trusted in-his-salvation.

**23** And-he-commanded clouds from-above, and-doors-of heaven he-opened.

**24** And-he-rained-down upon-them manna to-eat, and-grain-of heaven he-gave to-them.

**25** Bread-of the-mighty-ones a-man ate; provision he-sent to-them to-satisfaction.

**26** He-caused-to-journey the-east-wind in-the-heavens, and-he-drove by-his-power the-south-wind.

**27** And-he-rained upon-them like-dust flesh, and-like-sand-of the-seas birds-of wing.

**28** And-he-caused-to-fall in-midst-of his-camp, all-around to-his-dwellings.

**29** And-they-ate and-were-very-satisfied, and-their-desire he-brought to-them.

**30** Not they-were-estranged from their-desire; still their-food in-their-mouth,

**31** And-anger-of God went-up against-them, and-he-killed among-their-stoutest, and-young-men-of Israel he-brought-down.

**32** In-all this they-sinned still, and-not they-believed in-his-wonders.

**33** And-he-ended in-vanity their-days, and-their-years in-terror.

**34** When he-killed-them then-they-sought-him, and-they-returned and-sought-earnestly God.

**35** And-they-remembered that God their-rock, and-God Most-High their-redeemer.

**36** And-they-deceived-him with-their-mouth, and-with-their-tongue they-lied to-him.

**37** And-their-heart not was-steadfast with-him, and-not they-were-faithful in-his-covenant.

**38** And-he compassionate atones iniquity and-not destroys, and-increases to-turn-back his-anger, and-not rouses all his-wrath.

**39** And-he-remembered that flesh they-are, a-wind going and-not returning.

**40** How-many-times they-rebelled-against-him in-the-wilderness, they-grieved-him in-the-wasteland.

**41** And-they-returned and-tested God, and-the-Holy-One-of Israel they-provoked.

**42** Not they-remembered his-hand, the-day which he-redeemed-them from the-adversary,

**43** When he-set in-Egypt his-signs, and-his-wonders in-field-of Zoan.

**44** And-he-turned to-blood their-rivers, and-their-streams not they-could-drink.

**45** He-sent among-them swarms and-they-devoured-them, and-frogs and-they-destroyed-them.

**46** And-he-gave to-the-locust their-produce, and-their-labor to-the-swarming-locust.

**47** He-killed with-hail their-vines, and-their-sycamores with-frost.

**48** And-he-gave-over to-the-hail their-cattle, and-their-livestock to-the-thunderbolts.

**49** He-sent against-them burning-of his-anger, fury and-indignation and-distress, a-sending-of messengers-of evil.

**50** He-leveled a-path for-his-anger; not he-spared from-death their-soul, and-their-life to-the-plague he-gave-over.

**51** And-he-struck all firstborn in-Egypt, firstfruits-of vigor in-tents-of Ham.

**52** And-he-caused-to-journey like-sheep his-people, and-he-guided-them like-a-flock in-the-wilderness.

**53** And-he-led-them in-safety and-not they-feared, and-their-enemies covered the-sea.

**54** And-he-brought-them to border-of his-holiness, this mountain his-right-hand acquired.

**55** And-he-drove-out before-them nations, and-he-allotted-them by-line an-inheritance, and-he-settled in-their-tents the-tribes-of Israel.

**56** And-they-tested and-rebelled-against God Most-High, and-his-testimonies not they-kept.

**57** And-they-turned-back and-acted-treacherously like-their-fathers; they-twisted like-a-bow deceitful.

**58** And-they-provoked-him with-their-high-places, and-with-their-idols they-moved-him-to-jealousy.

**59** Heard God and-was-furious, and-he-rejected greatly Israel.

**60** And-he-abandoned the-tabernacle-of Shiloh, the-tent he-had-placed among-mankind.

**61** And-he-gave to-captivity his-strength, and-his-glory into-hand-of the-adversary.

**62** And-he-gave-over to-the-sword his-people, and-with-his-inheritance he-was-furious.

**63** His-young-men fire consumed, and-his-virgins not were-praised-in-wedding-songs.

**64** His-priests by-the-sword fell, and-his-widows not could-weep.

**65** And-awoke like-a-sleeper the-Lord, like-a-warrior shouting from-wine.

**66** And-he-struck his-adversaries backward; reproach of-forever he-gave to-them.

**67** And-he-rejected the-tent-of Joseph, and-tribe-of Ephraim not he-chose.

**68** And-he-chose the-tribe-of Judah, mount Zion which he-loved.

**69** And-he-built like-the-heights his-sanctuary, like-the-earth he-founded-it to-forever.

**70** And-he-chose David his-servant, and-he-took-him from-folds-of the-flock.

**71** From-behind nursing-ewes he-brought-him, to-shepherd Jacob his-people and-Israel his-inheritance.

**72** And-he-shepherded-them according-to-integrity-of his-heart, and-with-skillfulness-of his-hands he-guided-them.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **78:2**: Hebrew mashal ('parable') and chidot ('riddles') — this is didactic poetry using history as wisdom instruction.

- **78:25**: 'Bread-of the-mighty-ones' (lechem abbirim) — 'angels' bread'; abbirim can mean 'strong ones' = heavenly beings.

- **78:60-61**: Shiloh's destruction (1 Sam 4) — the Ark ('his-strength/glory') given to Philistine captivity. A warning that God's patience has limits.

- **78:65**: Startling anthropomorphism: YHWH 'awoke like a sleeper' — raw imagery of divine re-engagement after apparent absence.

— EMET
